title: ∮ x dy around the unit square
caption: Going anticlockwise round the unit square, only the right edge contributes to ∮ x dy: there x = 1 and y rises by 1, giving 1. The left edge has x = 0, and the top and bottom have dy = 0. Stokes' theorem says the same: ∬ dx ∧ dy is the area, 1.
alt: The unit square with anticlockwise arrows on its four edges. The right edge is labelled x = 1 and contributes 1; the left edge is labelled x = 0 and contributes 0; the area inside is 1.
description: ω = x dy, so dω = dx ∧ dy.
On the right edge x = 1 and ∫ dy = 1, so it contributes 1.
On the left edge x = 0, so it contributes 0; top and bottom have dy = 0.
The boundary integral is 1, equal to the area ∬ dx ∧ dy.

checks.name: the square has area 1, so ∬ dx ∧ dy = 1
